title: Screen Saver
description: Requires a password after sleep or screen saver and sets the login window's screen saver.
__jamf: Login Window → Screen Saver / Security & Privacy → General

askForPassword.title: Ask for password
askForPassword.description: If true, the device prompts the user for a password when the screen saver is unlocked or stopped. When you use this prompt, you must also provide askForPasswordDelay.

askForPasswordDelay.title: Ask for password delay
askForPasswordDelay.description: The number of seconds to delay before the device requires a password to unlock or stop the screen saver (the grace period). A value of 2147483647 (hexadecimal equivalent of 0x7FFFFFFF) disables this requirement, and a value of 0 immediately requires the password. To use this option, you must set askForPassword to true.

idleTime.title: Idle time
idleTime.description: The number of seconds of inactivity before the screen saver activates (0 = Never activate).

loginWindowModulePath.title: Login window module path
loginWindowModulePath.description: The full path to the screen-saver module to use.

moduleName.title: Module name
moduleName.description: The name of the screen saver module.
